content: For medical advice regarding side effects, consult your doctor. In Canada, contact your doctor for guidance on side effects. Precautions: Before starting a magnesium supplement, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other issues. Certain forms of this product, such as liquids or powders, may include sugar, aspartame, or alcohol. If you have diabetes, alcohol dependence, liver disease, phenylketonuria (PKU), or any condition requiring dietary restrictions, exercise caution. During pregnancy, use this product only if clearly necessary. It is unknown whether this product passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Magnesium can bind with certain medications, reducing their absorption. If you are taking tetracycline-type medications (e.g., demeclocycline, doxycycline, minocycline, tetracycline), separate the timing of these doses from magnesium supplements by at least 2 to 3 hours. Check the labels of all your medications, including antacids, laxatives, and vitamins, as they may contain magnesium. Overdose: If someone overdoses and experiences severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Notes: Regular lab and medical tests (e.g., magnesium blood levels, kidney function) should be conducted while using this medication. Keep all medical and lab appointments. Magnesium supplements are available in various forms and dosages, many of which are over-the-counter. Maintain a well-balanced diet. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this product at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This summary does not include all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
